description: Compose the masks for an analysed drawing exactly as mask_drawing will, without writing anything: which detections are masked (with their replacement in mode "replace") and which stay visible, custom-term matches, rectangles, the article-number stamp, the pages written, the anonymity score (0–100) with its warnings, the output file name, and visible_text_after_masking — the text a reader will still see on each page (from the PDF text layer). Use it to find leftovers (a customer name in the notes, a person the analysis missed) and add them as terms or rectangles. Deterministic and offline — iterate freely.

masking.description: Masking settings — shared by review_masking and mask_drawing; pass the same object to both so the PDF matches the reviewed masks. Everything is optional; the defaults reproduce the web app.

article_number.description: your own article number for this part — names the output file and can be stamped on the sheet

categories.description: categories masked automatically — default: CompanyName, Name, Address, PhoneNr, Email, Website, CompanyLogo, Other (ArticleNr, DrawingNr and Date stay visible for traceability). Pass the full list you want; [] masks no detection automatically.

company_name.description: own company name printed over detected company names in mode "replace" (max 32 characters)

detection_scope.description: page (default): mask detections anywhere on the sheet; title_block: only those inside the inferred title block (bottom-right), so notes elsewhere stay untouched. Explicit mask ids, terms and rectangles are never filtered.

include_report.description: append a masking coverage report page (default false)

logo_path.description: own logo (PNG or JPEG, < 1 MB) drawn into every detected logo instead of a blank box

mask.description: detection ids to mask regardless of their category

mode.description: whiteout (default): cover detections with blank boxes; replace: print replacement text inside the boxes (company_name for company names, replacements[] per detection)

name_after_article_number.description: name the output <article number>_masked.pdf (default true; falls back to the article number the analysis read, then the file name)

opacity.description: mask opacity 0–100 (default 100; below 100 the covered content stays readable)

rectangles.description: extra areas to cover, in analysis image pixels of the page (top-left origin, the same space as the detection boxes)

replacements.description: per-detection replacement text for mode "replace", e.g. [{"id": "…", "text": "Supplier GmbH"}] (max 32 characters each)

scrub_metadata.description: remove author, title, subject, keywords, creator and XMP from the document (default true)

secure.description: true (default): rasterize every page after masking so covered text and graphics are destroyed (tamper-proof single-layer PDF); false: layered PDF, masks painted over the intact content

stamp_article_number.description: print article_number top-right on the main page (default false)

terms.description: custom text to mask everywhere it appears (case- and spacing-insensitive, across split words), e.g. a customer or project name the analysis missed; needs the PDF text layer

unmask.description: detection ids to keep visible regardless of their category

name: review_masking
title: Review what the masked drawing will hide
